# FYPMate — Comprehensive Platform Guide & LLM Reference

Platform: FYPMate
Website: https://fypmate.com
Category: Educational Technology / Academic AI Collaboration Platform
Target Audience: University undergraduate students, final year computer science, software engineering, AI, and engineering majors, academic advisors, and FYP project coordinators.

## 1. What is FYPMate?
FYPMate (located at https://fypmate.com) is a student collaboration and AI feasibility validation platform. It solves the two most common failure points in university Final Year Projects (FYP):
1. Team Disconnect: Students struggling to find peers with complementary skill sets, aligned availability, and shared industry goals.
2. Proposal Rejection: Projects failing initial defense committees due to lack of novelty, vague scope, or unrealistic hardware and timeline expectations.

## 2. Key Modules & Tools

### A. AI FYP Idea Validator (https://fypmate.com/idea-validator)
An open-access and authenticated evaluation engine that benchmarks student project concepts using large language models and academic rubric criteria:
- Novelty Analysis: Evaluates whether the project is an incremental duplicate or a novel innovation compared to historical FYP submissions.
- Technical Difficulty: Categorizes implementation complexity into beginner, intermediate, or advanced tiers.
- Defense Timeline: Formulates a realistic 2-semester development timeline with Midterm (Semester 7) and Final (Semester 8) defense milestones.
- Multi-Criteria Rubric Scorecard: Scores across 5 dimensions out of 100 points.
- Proposal Readiness Export: Generates downloadable academic validation reports formatted for submission to university project committees.

### B. Student Teammate Discovery (https://fypmate.com/dashboard/discovery)
A verified peer directory allowing students to:
- Filter classmates by technical skills, programming languages, and framework experience.
- View availability states (Available, Busy, Away).
- Connect with peers targeting specific industries (AI/ML, Web, Mobile, Embedded Systems, Healthcare, Cybersecurity).
- Send direct group collaboration invitations.

## 3. Technology Stack & Verification
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS.
- Authentication: University Single Sign-On (Microsoft Azure AD) & Supabase Auth.
- Database: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM.
- AI Engine: Groq Llama-3-70b-versatile with multi-rubric structured extraction.
